text:
Jules (PM): uploaded a small interactive flow for quick-review microflows + voiceover hints. looking for fast takes on: (A) inline threshold edits vs a tiny confirm step, (B) show regressions arrival to VO users, (C) compact list hit targets & separators, (D) wording for bulk actions. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/yyy/evals-quick-review

Nina (Designer): liked the microflow. leaning toward inline edits with a lightweight confirm sheet (slide-up) that lists affected tests. keeps context vs a modal. visual: when compact, remove thin dividers and increase left padding for avatars so rows breathe.

Diego (Frontend): inline + slide-up doable. virtualization note: keep row heights predictable in compact mode (fixed 56px) to keep windowing smooth. expansion toggles can render full content lazily. also suggest using CSS variable --row-gap for presets.

Rae (A11y): voiceover/VO notes: announce new regressions with an aria-live=\"assertive\" region when it is critical, otherwise \"polite\". add role=\"list\" + role=\"listitem\" semantics for the diff list. for inline confirm sheet, ensure focus traps into the sheet and restore focus to the edited control after dismiss. also: color choices must meet 3:1 for UI chrome and 4.5:1 for body text.

Omar (Evals): on thresholds: store change metadata inline (small timestamp + initials) and show a hover tooltip with full changelog. when batch applying a threshold, preview count before commit. would like an undo window (5s toast) and a rollback API hook.

Kai (Copy): proposed alternatives for bulk CTA (short list):
- Apply to visible (neutral)
- Mark reviewed (friendly)
- Accept changes (formal)
My vote: 'Mark reviewed' for flows where human verification is main action. use microcopy under the button: \"This flags tests as reviewed for the current prompt set.\"

Diego (Frontend): keyboard shortcuts draft:
```
ArrowDown / j -> next row
ArrowUp / k -> prev row
Enter -> expand diff
r -> open threshold inline edit
m -> mark reviewed (selected)
Shift+m -> mark reviewed (all visible)
/ -> focus quick filter
? -> shortcuts help overlay
```
Implement aria-activedescendant on the list container so screen readers track selection.

Rae (A11y): shortcuts overlay should be keyboard-focusable and announced as \"Shortcuts\" with role=\"dialog\" and aria-modal=\"false\". for undo toast, make it reachable via tab and include an explicit \"Undo\" button. ensure all buttons have accessible names and visible focus rings.

Nina (Designer): tiny visual nit: when a row is selected via keyboard, use a left-border highlight (4px) instead of full background to reduce visual noise in dense views.

Omar (Evals): regression badges must persist in condensed mode. collapse preview to single-sentence summary with ellipses. keep count and severity color.

DeployBot: staging build with quick-review flow is live at /app/evals?feature=quick-review-2026 — please smoke test.

Jules (PM): TL;DR / action items: Nina -> finalize compact spacing + selected-left-border mock. Rae -> accessibility checklist (aria-live rules, focus restore, dialog attrs). Diego -> implement fixed-height compact POC + keyboard map POC. Omar -> spec undo toast + changelog tooltip. Kai -> finalize copy for bulk CTA and microcopy. I'll create a tracked ticket and tag infra for rollback API. Thanks all :rocket:
